name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Afghanistan–Pakistan border fighting continues with heavy weapons
state: Taliban and Pakistani forces clashed at least three times between 19 and 28 Oct, with heavy weapons on the Paktika border and fighting at the Torkham crossing; Pakistani authorities said a mortar killed one civilian on 27 Oct (Long War Journal, 29 Oct). The latest round began after a suicide attack killed 31 people on 18 Sep.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Afghanistan and to parts of Pakistan near the border.
